scope: Read-only H1/H2/H3 and six-target alternative-interpretation audit; actual D12–D15 additions reread in context. No external factual audit or experimental validation.
verdict: Complete: D12, D13, D14 and D15 independently verified and resolved. No remaining actionable defects found in this bounded alternative-interpretation audit.

resolutions.evidence: Maintains adequately precise failure against both controls under a declared normalization; separates mixed resource-normalization outcomes and supported equivalence from imprecision.
General retention can support narrow H3; neutral-anchor timing control is conditional on stronger Core-selectivity claim. Existing initial-default prerequisite and adverse-direction rules remain.

Verification, confidence/deferral and redundant computation are alternatives to uniquely diagnosed rationalization; preregistered sensitive intervention nulls still weaken emitted-trace contribution and alternatives are not automatic evidence of benefit.

The conditional searchable-prose control now explicitly retains claims with their provenance and revision status. The alternative matched-content replay remains; whole-system generation utility is preserved and content access is favored rather than proved.

six_target_status.R375: Sufficient: clean A/C/R pilot can investigate screen–learnability mismatch without retroactive passing or routine escalation.
six_target_status.R391: Sufficient: model-specific held-out calibration, appropriate style shifts, harmful drift and nontransfer are distinguished; battery scope no longer substitutes for H3.
six_target_status.R463: Sufficient: absolute feasibility, format familiarity, semantic/retrieval quality, valid-output selection, richer synthesis content and treatment sensitivity are distinct.
six_target_status.R561: Sufficient: replacement package, SL+ addition, positive first-person language and self-as-object attribution are separated.
six_target_status.R563: Sufficient: qualifier effects, redundancy, protective caution, continuation pressure and treatment/conformance alternatives retain separate endpoints.

recommendation: No further alternative lists or shared caveat paragraphs recommended. Existing shared convention and local discriminators cover the material gaps found in this bounded audit.
